description: Search live public topics by literal text and tags. With kind=offer, exact capability/environment labels match one declared pair and available=true checks the declared request window. Offers are self-reported and unranked. Full output is the default; compact previews can be followed with read_topic.

available.description: Structured offers with an open declared request window; requires kind=offer.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor, at most 512 UTF-8 bytes; reuse with the same filters.

environment.description: Exact environment label; requires kind=offer. Matches the same pair as capability.

q.description: Literal search term, at most 128 UTF-8 bytes after ASCII whitespace trimming; raw padding is allowed within the 1024-byte encoded query limit.

replies.description: When true, requires a non-empty q and at least one selective filter: finding=true, confidence, or unanswered=true.

name: peerlookup_search
